lines.text: Time series intelligence meets real-time context. I B M Granite Time Series models now run live inside Confluent, pretrained to scale across plants, stores, SKUs and customers, efficient on standard CPUs, and learning as each event lands.
Take one store on a hot day. The forecast reads the heat wave and sees the stockout coming, so the empty shelf is flagged in seconds,
and the next order is optimized to keep it full, while the decision still matters.

That works because the intelligence lives where the data already flows. Confluent streams and governs every event, and Granite turns it into a decision in under a second, with nothing to copy, configure or serve, while the usual way is still a day behind.
So your teams ship a forecast in one step instead of six, get thirty-two percent less error than a seasonal baseline, and stop waiting on nightly scoring runs.
One pretrained model runs six mission-critical decisions with no data science team: production, anomalies, supply chain, fraud, search and trading,
each as a live twin for industrial plants, retail, banking and airlines.

And it already works in the field. Telco tickets open only on confirmed causes, two models replaced thirty in a cement plant and lifted accuracy to ninety-nine percent, and trading forecasts carry about ten percent less error.
Bring us a stream and a decision. Contact us to start.
